podcast.body: The Beatles' famous rendition of this song was a cover based on The Isley Brothers' version, released on their first UK album, *Please Please Me*, with John Lennon on lead vocals. It served as the opening song for their Vancouver concert on August 22, 1964, and was notably available in Canada almost a year before the group's significant breakthrough in the United States. "The song was a cover based on the Isley Brothers version, the Beatles' rendition of Twist and Shout was released on their first UK album, Please Please Me, and John Lennon provided lead vocals."

podcast.body: The most famous cover on The Beatles' debut album, which evolved into a full-on rock and roll track. Their version reached number 2 on the Hot 100 at the height of American Beatlemania, and the group famously closed their set with it at Queen Elizabeth's Royal Variety performance in late 1963. "Their version would eventually reach number 2 on the Hot 100 at the height of American Beetlemania."
